name: Sumitomo Bakelite Company Limited
summary: Sumitomo Bakelite Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor materials, plastic products, and life products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Semiconductor Related Materials, High Performance Plastic, and Quality of Life Related Products segments. The company offers epoxy resin molding materials for semiconductor encapsulation, liquid resin for photosensitive wafer coating, liquid resin for semiconductors, and semiconductor substrate materials.
